headline: Nifty stood still while *smallcaps surged 2.19%*
subline: Midcaps and smallcaps led. Breadth stayed with the move.
hero_text: Smallcap 250 rose 2.19% while Nifty slipped 0.02%. FIIs bought Rs 4,240.39 Cr as DIIs sold Rs 1,250.03 Cr.

why.title: Nifty ended flat, no trigger
why.desc: The index slipped with no clear catalyst. 25 names rose, 25 fell.

why.title: Pharma ran on broad buying
why.desc: Nifty Pharma rose 1.91%, well ahead of the frontline index.

why.title: Foreign cash came in
why.desc: FIIs bought in cash while DIIs sold the other way.

sector_reasons.Media: Topped the board on a sharp bid
sector_reasons.Pharma: Large and midcap drug names both rallied
sector_reasons.Private Bank: Private lenders slipped and capped Nifty
sector_reasons.Bank: SBI's slide weighed on the group
sector_reasons.Financials: Banks dragged while non bank lenders held

bonus_text: FIIs bought Rs 4,240.39 Cr in cash. DIIs sold Rs 1,250.03 Cr. The two sides moved in opposite directions.
movers_note_gainers: Tata Consumer led. Bharti Airtel and Bajaj Auto followed.
movers_note_losers: Asian Paints fell most. Coal India, Grasim and SBI trailed.
watch_text: Expiry day OI pinned Nifty between 22,750 and 22,800. Bank Nifty max pain sat at 54,300.
lessons: A flat index hid a wide tape. Advancers beat decliners by more than two to one.
Size led the day. Smallcaps beat midcaps, and midcaps beat the frontline.
Banks held the index back while pharma, realty and media ran.
Institutions split. FIIs bought in cash while DIIs sold.
alert_text: The UK Budget and the US Fed rate decision both fall around Wednesday's session.
cta_headline: Flat Nifty, hot smallcaps. *Save it for Wednesday*.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Next bell is Wednesday 28 October.
next_text: Wednesday 28 October opens with the UK Budget and the US Fed rate decision in play.

Watch: Nifty OI pinned between 22,750 and 22,800.
